description: A slender, yellow-brown shark with a blunt snout, ridges along its back and flanks, dark spots all over, and a long, low tail fin almost as long as the rest of the body. Juveniles are dark brown with pale stripes and spots, which gave it the name zebra shark. It rests on sand by day and at night wriggles into reef crevices to suck out shellfish, crustaceans and small fish.
